title: Chintamani Library v2.8.3 — Gemini AI Chatbot, Real Global Search & Locker Fixes
releaseNotes: GEMINI AI CHATBOT: Floating draggable AI assistant powered by Gemini 1.5 Flash with live database grounding — ask anything about members, seats, lockers, and library stats
REAL GLOBAL SEARCH: Rebuilt search from scratch — searches Members, Seats, Lockers, Complaints, Registrations, and Notifications with live backend results, debounce, and cancel support
LOCKER FIX: Lockers with no active member now correctly show 'Unassigned' instead of incorrectly showing 'Occupied'
CLEAN NOTIFICATIONS: Removed all demo/mock notifications — notification centre now shows only real backend notifications
NO GREEN DOTS: Removed all unread indicator dots from dashboard header and notification items
QR SCANNER: Universal QR portal now includes a direct Camera Attendance Scanner launch button
